verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a hosted feedback and support SaaS, and offering its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public repository, an open-source license, or source availability. The pack covers only APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and hosted features, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
